summary: Backend refactoring regression testing complete. All 69 API endpoint tests passed (100%). Fixed 4 bugs discovered during testing related to model field name mismatches and function signature issues.

bugs_fixed.issue: PricingDefaults model requires tenant_id but get_pricing_defaults() was not passing it
Pricing calculator functions used data.width/height but model has width_inches/length_inches
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated all pricing calculator functions to use correct field names (width_inches, length_inches, etc.)
bugs_fixed.lines: Multiple functions: calculate_rigid_signs, calculate_cut_vinyl, calculate_digital_print, calculate_apparel, calculate_vehicle_graphics, calculate_services, calculate_custom, calculate_promotional

bugs_fixed.issue: log_job_activity function signature mismatch - invoices.py called with new_value but function required user_id/user_name
bugs_fixed.fix: Made all parameters optional in log_job_activity to support both call patterns

bugs_fixed.issue: PayrollTransaction date field failed when input.date was None
bugs_fixed.fix: Filter out None values before creating PayrollTransaction to allow defaults to work

bugs_fixed.issue: JobActivity model missing user_id, user_name, metadata fields
bugs_fixed.fix: Added optional user_id, user_name, metadata fields to JobActivity model

passed_tests: ✅ Auth: POST /api/auth/register creates user and tenant
✅ Auth: Login with remember_me flag extends token expiry
✅ Users: GET /api/users/me returns current user profile
✅ Customers: Full CRUD (create, read, update, delete)
✅ Customers: Search and filter by status
✅ Quotes: POST /api/quotes/{id}/convert-to-job creates job from quote
✅ Invoices: POST /api/invoices/from-job/{id} creates invoice from job
✅ Pricing: POST /api/pricing/calculate works for all categories (rigid_signs, cut_vinyl, apparel, etc.)
critical_code_review_comments: Backend refactoring successful - server.py reduced from 6349 to ~780 lines
All routes properly imported and registered in server.py
Model field naming inconsistency between pricing calculator functions and JobItemPricingData model was fixed
log_job_activity function now supports both call patterns (with user info or with old/new values)
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed PricingDefaults instantiation, log_job_activity signature, pricing calculator field names)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed customers, quotes, jobs, invoices, employees, products, webstores during testing
